Fixed and verified — Arabic names now render correctly (e.g. `محمد أحمد`), and existing tests still pass.

**Root cause:** `display_name` encoded the name to UTF-8, truncated by raw bytes, then decoded with `"ascii", errors="ignore"` — which silently dropped every non-ASCII byte. Any name outside ASCII (Arabic, but also accented Latin, Cyrillic, CJK, etc.) came out empty or mangled. Fixed by truncating the string directly by character count instead of byte-mangling through ASCII (`app/display.py:1-4`).
